title: Lead Content Writer
description:
We are looking for a talented Lead Content Writer to join our dynamic team at American Red Cross. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining marketing solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 4 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Content Strategy, SEM, Email Marketing, Salesforce
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of £30,000 – £50,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

title: Director of Mechanical Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented Director of Mechanical Engineer to join our dynamic team at Macy's. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 6 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Problem Solving, JavaScript, Stakeholder Management, Team Management
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of £30,000 – £50,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

- Competitive salary of £100,000 – £140,000 per year

- 100% remote — work from anywhere

We are looking for a talented Director of Senior Software Engineer to join our dynamic team at Princeton University. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining tech solutions that drive business growth and innovation.

**Key Responsibilities:**
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
- Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code/work
- Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs
- Mentor junior team members and share knowledge across the organization
- Communicate effectively with stakeholders to understand business requirements

**Requirements:**
- 4 years of experience in a similar role
- Strong proficiency in Problem Solving, Python, TypeScript, Analytical Thinking
- Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience
- Strong communication and collaboration skills

**What We Offer:**
- Competitive salary of £100,000 – £140,000 per year
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Generous PTO and paid holidays
- Learning and development budget
- Collaborative and inclusive work environment

description:
Unilever is seeking a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

As a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our marketing capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

title: Mid-Level Account Executive
description:
Join U.S. Food and Drug Administration as a Mid-Level Account Executive and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Mid-Level Account Executive with strong expertise in finance. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute finance projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 9 years of experience as a Mid-Level Account Executive or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Financial Modeling, GAAP, Budgeting, Microsoft Office
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: £75,000 – £100,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

Join Ohio University as a Mid-Level Project Manager and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Mid-Level Project Manager with strong expertise in marketing. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute marketing projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 5 years of experience as a Mid-Level Project Manager or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Project Management, Communication, HubSpot, Stakeholder Management
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: £75,000 – £100,000
- 100% remote — work from anywhere
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities
